topic.title: Which state touches the most other states? Uttar Pradesh and its ring of neighbours
topic.map_answer: Uttar Pradesh lifted in the middle of the map with a ring of neighbouring states lighting round it, more than round Maharashtra or Assam

shape.name: The ring
shape.beats: hook: three candidate states lit, the question -> candidate one and its ring of neighbours -> candidate two and its ring -> the turn: the winner lifts -> its neighbours light one by one round it, a counter climbing -> payoff: the count, plus the country beyond -> loop: your state's ring?
shape.why: a 'which one has the most' question answered on the map by rings of neighbours; every viewer checks their own state
